MEDICAL: Call 112 immediately if not already done.
Keep the person calm and still.
Do not move someone who may have a spinal injury.
If unconscious and breathing: place in recovery position.
If not breathing: begin CPR if trained.
Apply pressure to any visible bleeding wounds with a clean cloth.
Do not give food or water.
Stay with the person until help arrives.
FIRE: Activate the nearest fire alarm pull station.
Evacuate via the nearest marked emergency exit — do NOT use lifts.
Close doors behind you to slow fire spread.
If smoke is present, stay low and cover your nose and mouth.
Do not re-enter the building for any reason.
Proceed to the designated assembly point and await headcount.
If trapped: seal door gaps with cloth, signal from a window.
THREAT: Move to the nearest secure indoor location immediately.
Lock or barricade the door and turn off lights.
Silence your phone and stay away from windows.
Call 100 (police) or 112 when safe to do so.
Do not open the door until an all-clear is given by authorities.
If evacuation is ordered, leave belongings and move quickly.
Follow instructions from security personnel only.
Do not post real-time location on social media.
ACCIDENT: Do not move the injured person unless there is immediate danger.
Keep bystanders back to give the injured person space.
If trained, assess airway, breathing, circulation.
Control bleeding with firm, continuous pressure.
Keep the person warm with a blanket if available.
Note the time of the accident for first responders.
Stay calm and reassure the injured person help is on the way.
